cases.name: yield_latency_1999ms
cases.description: Model turn [1000,4999]; C [3000,6000] starts during it. Yield latency 4999-3000 = 1999 <= 2000: a yield. Rate 1/1. No later onset, so resume 0/1.

cases.name: yield_latency_exactly_2000ms_is_a_yield
cases.description: Model turn [1000,5000], C starts 3000: latency exactly 2000. Docs: exactly 2000 ms counts as a yield. Rate 1/1, mean 2000, resume 0/1.

cases.name: yield_latency_2001ms_is_not_a_yield
cases.description: Model turn [1000,5001], C starts 3000: latency 2001 > 2000. One interruption, zero yields: yield_rate 0/1 = 0, no yields so mean latency and resume rate are null.

cases.name: yield_uses_merged_model_turn_end
cases.description: Segments [1000,2000] and [2300,3500] (gap 300 < 500) merge into turn [1000,3500]. C [1500,5000] starts during the first segment. Latency is turn end minus C start = 3500-1500 = 2000 (a yield); using the first segment end would give 500.

cases.name: counterpart_start_during_model_backchannel_is_not_an_interruption
cases.description: Model backchannel [1000,1800] (800 ms, no words); C [1500,3000] starts during it. Not a substantive turn, so zero interruptions: yield_rate, yield latency and resume are null. The backchannel overlaps counterpart speech [1500,1800]: benign 1/1 eligible.

cases.name: yield_latencies_mean_and_rate
cases.description: Three interruptions: M [1000,3500] vs C [3000,4000] lat 500; M [13000,15500] vs C [14000,15000] lat 1500; M [24000,29000] vs C [26000,27000] lat 3000 (no yield). Yields 2/3, mean (500+1500)/2 = 1000. Resume: no substantive onset after either yield within 5000 ms of the interrupter end (9000, 20000): 0/2.

cases.name: resume_boundary_5000ms_after_interrupter_end
cases.description: M1 [1000,3500] yields to C [3000,9000] (lat 500). New onset at 14000 = C end 9000 + 5000: counts (no later than). Measured from the interrupter END (from its start it would be 8000).

cases.name: resume_5001ms_after_interrupter_end_is_too_late
cases.description: Same as the boundary case with the new onset at 14001 = C end + 5001: not a resume. 0/1.

cases.name: resume_during_the_interrupting_turn
cases.description: M1 [1000,3500] yields to C [3000,9000]. A new substantive onset at 7000 is after the yield (3500) and before C ends: still a resume, 1/1.

cases.name: resume_ignores_backchannel_after_yield
cases.description: M1 [1000,3500] yields to C [3000,6000]. Only a backchannel [7000,7500] follows: not a substantive onset, so no resume, 0/1.

cases.name: resume_rate_one_yield_one_non_yield
cases.description: Yield: M1 [1000,3500] vs C1 [3000,4000] lat 500, followed by M2 onset 6000 (<= 9000): resumed. Non-yield: M3 [9000,15000] vs C2 [10000,11000], lat 5000. yield_rate 1/2, mean 500. AMBIGUOUS denominator for resume_rate: yielded interruptions (1/1 = 1.0) is asserted; all interruptions would give 0.5.

cases.name: pause_tolerance_onset_199ms_after_pause_end
cases.description: C [0,8000] with scripted pause [3000,5000]. Onset 5199 is 199 ms after the pause end, inside the 200 ms grace: pause failure, tolerance 0/1.

cases.name: pause_tolerance_onset_exactly_200ms_after_pause_end
cases.description: Onset 5200 = pause end + 200. AMBIGUOUS boundary: 'until 200 ms after its end' read as inclusive, so a failure, 0/1.

cases.name: pause_tolerance_onset_201ms_after_pause_end
cases.description: Onset 5201 is past the grace: tolerated, 1/1.

cases.name: pause_tolerance_onset_at_pause_start
cases.description: Onset 3000 = pause start: window runs from the pause start, so a failure, 0/1. The same onset is an early start for timing: early 1/1, answered, no latency.

cases.name: pause_tolerance_onset_before_pause_start
cases.description: Onset 2999 is 1 ms before the pause start; the turn runs on into the pause but no new onset occurs from the pause start: tolerated, 1/1.

cases.name: pause_tolerance_backchannel_in_pause_is_tolerated
cases.description: Backchannel [3500,4000] (500 ms) inside the scripted pause is not a substantive onset: tolerated, 1/1.

cases.name: pause_tolerance_half_of_two_pauses
cases.description: Scripted pauses [3000,5000] and [8000,10000] in C [0,12000]. Onset 3000 breaks the first; nothing in the second window [8000,10200]. Tolerance 1/2, count 2.

cases.name: pause_tolerance_all_tolerated_without_model_speech
cases.description: Two scripted pauses, silent model: 2/2 tolerated.

cases.name: pause_tolerance_null_without_scripted_pauses
cases.description: No scripted pauses: pause_tolerance is undefined (0 denominator).
